description: Source code for a netlink socket library, including socket allocation, port management, group subscription, socket configuration, and utility functions.

methods.name: generate_local_port
methods.description: Generates a unique local port number based on process ID and port usage map.

methods.name: release_local_port
methods.description: Releases a previously allocated local port number.

methods.name: __alloc_socket
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new netlink socket structure with callback.

methods.name: nl_socket_alloc
methods.description: Creates a new netlink socket with default callback.

methods.name: nl_socket_alloc_cb
methods.description: Creates a new netlink socket with custom callback.

methods.name: nl_socket_free
methods.description: Frees and cleans up a netlink socket.

methods.name: nl_socket_disable_seq_check
methods.description: Disables sequence number checking on a socket.

methods.name: nl_socket_set_local_port
methods.description: Sets or generates a local port for the socket.

methods.name: nl_socket_set_nonblocking
methods.description: Sets the socket to non-blocking mode.

methods.name: nl_socket_set_buffer_size
methods.description: Sets socket buffer sizes for receive and transmit.

methods.name: nl_socket_recv_pktinfo
methods.description: Enables or disables reception of packet info.
